maintenance_led.reason: Sells new and renewing specialty insurance policies (D&O, casualty, healthcare liability), not repair or maintenance of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Premiums paid by private companies, healthcare providers, nonprofits and other organizations buying liability coverage through brokers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows organically by underwriting more specialty premiums through brokers; affiliated with American Family, no acquisition roll-up strategy.

mission_critical.reason: Specialty liability policies are re-placed by brokers annually and carriers can be swapped fairly easily at renewal.

notes: Insurance can be contractually required, but annual broker re-placement makes switching relatively easy; the mission-critical answer is a judgment call.
